# Evidence: Haq before vs after

This file shows what changed between the first eval run (the baseline) and the current code, and the evidence
behind each change. Every number below comes from the committed results files in `evals/`. No expected answer in
`evals/families.json` has been changed since it was created in
[`893473d`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/893473de9dda7fca0b87d8f9e44382bc841218c2).

| Run | Results file | Households | Setup |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Baseline** | `evals/results-20261010-160806.json` | h01–h10 | Sonnet 5.5 for every step, no cache, 4 workers |
| After: smoke test, warm cache | `evals/results-20261010-171541.json` | h09 | current code, 1 worker |
| After: warm cache | `evals/results-20261010-171810.json` | h01–h07, h10 | current code, 4 workers |
| After: cold cache | `evals/results-20261010-172025.json` | h09 | current code, `HAQ_NO_CACHE=1`, 1 worker |

## 1. Before vs after

These are the **9 households that had a wrong or missed scheme in the baseline**: h01–h07, h09 and h10. h08 was
fully correct in the baseline and was not re-run. The "after" column uses the warm-cache h09 run and the batch of
8. Rupee amounts use an assumed rate of ₹88 per US dollar.

| Metric | Baseline | After |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy (TP / (TP + FP + FN)) | 0.50 | **0.86** |
| Precision | 0.71 | **0.97** |
| Recall | 0.64 | **0.89** |
| Wrong schemes (FP) | 8 | **1** |
| Missed schemes (FN) | 10 | **3** |
| Cost per household | $0.93 (≈ ₹82) | **$0.22 (≈ ₹20)** |
| Total cost for 9 households | $8.35 (≈ ₹735) | **$2.00 (≈ ₹176)** |
| Time per household | 147 s | **59 s** |

Per household:

| Household | Baseline: wrong / missed | After: wrong / missed | After: cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| h01 | nfsa_ration, up_shadi_anudan / up_scholarship | — / — | $0.270 |
| h02 | up_shadi_anudan / up_widow_pension, pmjay, pmay_g | — / — | $0.239 |
| h03 | nfsa_ration / — | — / — | $0.073 |
| h04 | nfsa_ration / — | — / — | $0.185 |
| h05 | — / up_bocw, nfsa_ration | pm_vishwakarma / up_bocw, pmuy | $0.205 |
| h06 | nfsa_ration / up_scholarship | — / up_kanya_sumangala | $0.337 |
| h07 | — / nfsa_ration, pmay_g | — / — | $0.353 |
| h09 | nfsa_ration / — | — / — | $0.112 |
| h10 | nfsa_ration / up_scholarship | — / — | $0.226 |

Known remaining errors:

- **h05, wrong scheme:** PM Vishwakarma for a construction worker. This is arguably defensible, because masons
  are one of the scheme's trades, but it is not in the expected list.
- **h05, missed schemes:** UP BOCW and Ujjwala.
- **h06, missed scheme:** Kanya Sumangala.

## 2. Likely eligible vs confirmed

A scheme is labelled **"Likely eligible — confirm income limit"** when its core eligibility (who the scheme is
for) is confirmed on an official page but the income limit is not. Likely schemes are shown on the cards with that
label and are not counted in the confirmed ₹ total.

| Group | Number of predictions | Expected answer | Optional extra | Wrong |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Likely eligible | 15 | 13 | 2 | **0** |
| Confirmed | 15 | 15 | — | 1 (h05 PM Vishwakarma) |

| Metric (same 9 households) | All predictions | Confirmed only |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy | 0.86 | 0.52 |
| Precision | 0.97 | 0.94 |
| Recall | 0.89 | 0.54 |

The likely group is mostly the widow and old-age pensions, PM-JAY, UP scholarships and the ration card. For these
schemes the official portals confirm who qualifies but do not publish the income limit.

## 3. Warm vs cold cache (h09, same household)

| | Warm cache | Cold cache (`HAQ_NO_CACHE=1`) |
|---|---|---|
| Cost | **$0.112** (≈ ₹10) | $0.241 (≈ ₹21) |
| Time | 47 s | 122 s |
| Score | 4/4, 0 wrong | 4/4, 0 wrong |
| Sonnet calls / cost | 6 / $0.111 | 14 / $0.240 |
| Haiku calls / cost | 2 / $0.001 | 2 / $0.001 |
| Web searches | 0 | 3 |
| Sonnet tokens read from cache / written to cache | 5,656 / 18,018 | 200,637 / 27,646 |

What this shows:

- **Haiku structured outputs work.** The interview, plan and summary steps all returned valid structured output.
- **Prompt caching works on both models.** In the cold run, the Haiku plan step read 2,646 cached tokens that the
  warm run had written a few minutes earlier.
- **Where the warm-cache rules came from.** The warm cache holds rules for 19 schemes. They were imported, with no
  new API calls, from baseline lookups that had already been paid for (`python -m haq.cache seed`).

## 4. Fixes, commits and the evidence for each

### About the neatlogs trace identifiers

The **neatlogs trace IDs (OpenTelemetry trace ids) were not recorded at run time**, so they are not listed here.
Each bug below is identified instead by three things, which together are enough to find the trace in the neatlogs
dashboard:

- the **trace name**, for example `eval:h03`, in workflow `haq-evals`
- the **span name**, for example `research:nfsa_ration:household`
- the **session id**, which is the household id

| Run | Session ids (household ids) |
|---|---|
| Baseline | h01 `1d89d89faa`, h02 `f7de572297`, h03 `eee3110444`, h04 `531b815edb`, h05 `656e07dcc6`, h06 `819b1ae51c`, h07 `cf70fbe6c8`, h08 `b45c4ae89e`, h09 `f4980ec823`, h10 `391532689f` |
| Aborted re-run, before fixes 6–7 | h01 `b0a76752da`, h02 `0dc8661720`, h03 `9621321743`, h04 `0a706b5470` |
| Manual test household (workflow `haq`) | `1039c7bd51` |

### Accuracy fixes

| # | Fix | Commit | Evidence (neatlogs trace / span / session) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Don't recommend a ration card to families that already hold one | [`658fe54`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/658fe5471f83970aa72a3b5b973c04fdf76a834d) | `eval:h01`, `eval:h03`, `eval:h04`, `eval:h06`, `eval:h09`, `eval:h10`. Span `research:nfsa_ration:household` ended in `record_verified` even though the profile already had an Antyodaya or eligible-household card. This caused 6 of the 8 baseline wrong schemes. Sessions are the baseline ids above. |
| 2 | Marriage grants only when a marriage is actually coming up | [`bddd5d9`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/bddd5d9921cba320f156cc74ee776b920680f192) | `eval:h01` (`1d89d89faa`) and `eval:h02` (`f7de572297`). Span `research:up_shadi_anudan:daughter` recorded the scheme for girls aged 12 and 7. The same bug appeared in the manual test `1039c7bd51` (daughter aged 13). |
| 3 | "Likely eligible — confirm income limit" instead of dropping the scheme | [`5baa497`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/5baa497f20a3adc52b65900e1652a09dd7dc32c8) | `eval:h02` (`f7de572297`): `research:up_widow_pension:self` was dropped although sspy-up.gov.in confirmed "widow, 18+". `eval:h06` (`819b1ae51c`) and `eval:h10` (`391532689f`): `research:up_scholarship:*` was dropped because the income limit appeared only on buddy4study. |
| 4 | Read official rule PDFs and the legacy-TLS state portals | [`30fbc1f`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/30fbc1f7bf0e83dd8c521ac5fcf156f2a8d269b8) | `eval:h01`, `eval:h06`, `eval:h10`: the `fetch_url_with_retry` spans for scholarship.up.gov.in failed 3 out of 3 times with `SSL: UNSAFE_LEGACY_RENEGOTIATION_DISABLED`. This caused all 4 scholarship misses. `eval:h02` and `eval:h07` (`cf70fbe6c8`): `research:pmay_g:household` found only the portal home page, while the rules are in the guidelines PDF. |
| 5 | Actually record conflicts when non-government sources are read | [`6b33c05`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/6b33c05af8d6d35f64e17f402a3ad8ea04f5348e) | The baseline logged 0 conflicts. Meanwhile `eval:h06` relied on buddy4study, `eval:h07` on kotak811 and bajajfinserv, and `eval:h02` on private sites for PM-JAY. After the fix, 8 unofficial claims were logged and none were used as a rule. |
| 6 | Tolerate stringified tool arrays; stop hung runs after a fatal API error | [`d0acca4`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/d0acca40ac86b96d7c25d1007c7f71a4f66d64c9) | Aborted re-run, `eval:h03` (`9621321743`): `research:ayushman_vay_vandana:self` raised `TypeError: string indices must be integers`. Aborted re-run, `eval:h01`, `eval:h02`, `eval:h04` (`b0a76752da`, `0dc8661720`, `0a706b5470`): runs stayed `running` for 30+ minutes because a `CancelledError` escaped `except Exception`. This commit contains both fixes. |
| 7 | Bound every network wait (API client timeout, fetch deadline) | [`c4f4f2e`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/c4f4f2efe12f8f55bee38c4567039ff63370fefb) | Same aborted re-run, `eval:h01`, `eval:h02`, `eval:h04`: research spans stayed open for 30+ minutes. Neither the API client nor page downloads had a total time limit. |
| — | Don't save failed lookups, so a resume retries them | [`4e86960`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/4e8696050afa474788a837f47544d44ecc9eb524) | Manual test `1039c7bd51` (workflow `haq`): 4 candidates were saved as "dropped" with a billing error as the reason. |

### Cost fixes

The evidence for these is the baseline token profile (results file `20261010-160806`):

- **$4.92 of the $9.23 (53%) was cache writes** of web-search results.
- There were **121 scheme lookups for only 24 distinct schemes**. PMSBY was looked up 19 times and PMJJBY 15 times.

| # | Change | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | Cache official pages (7 days) and verified scheme rules (30 days) on disk | [`0138493`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/0138493ca10acfad6e25333ff5a3d0a2b8f7c890) |
| C2 | Haiku for the interview, plan, summary and follow-ups; Sonnet only for verification | [`9c0ecf2`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/9c0ecf27199f6ab612c30a63abec34cf2e266546) |
| C3 | At most 2 web searches per scheme; stop once an official page confirms the rules | [`52498bf`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/52498bf2c082d0d33ffe16b44204eec4a857ae48) |
| C4 | Prompt caching for the system prompt and scheme rules | [`bc74be2`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/bc74be23cffc31f93b9873cf07f86de6c98677ae) |
| C5 | One research loop per scheme that decides all of a family's members together. Evidence: `eval:h01` and `eval:h04` ran PMSBY and PMJJBY loops separately for each of 3–4 members. | [`2ebc2d4`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/2ebc2d48de468418902c45bdb7f82826cc48ce35) |
| C6 | Low Sonnet effort when it only has to apply fully confirmed cached rules | [`fb5d8f0`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/fb5d8f0a89bb837cc0735b39cd30778d06421995) |
| C7 | Report usage and cost per model | [`3b0ec4c`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/3b0ec4cb3baaa6927e54287c01e7277afd5e16dd) |

The baseline results are in [`52fbe91`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/52fbe910c6e9f955cdfec25a8a5a588bf5b71f45)
and the after results are in [`5faa21b`](https://github.com/rohitraj2496-source/Hackathon_1/commit/5faa21b80b556584c0ff75e33bd81aa31445e22c).

## 5. Caveats

- **Expected answers are unchecked.** Every expected answer is still marked `needs_human_check: true` and has not
  been spot-checked by a person.
- **Not every household is covered.** Only the 9 baseline-error households were re-run. h08 and h11–h20 have not

  used 4 workers.

def run_one(household: dict) -> dict:

        with neatlogs.trace(f"eval:{household['id']}", kind="WORKFLOW", session_id=hid, eval_case=household["id"]):
            run = agent.run(hid)
    except Exception as e:  # keep scoring the rest; a crash counts as predicting nothing
        err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        run = state.latest_run(hid)
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    cards = (run or {}).get("result", {}) or {}
    cards = cards.get("cards", [])
    predicted = {catalog.canonical_id(c["scheme_id"]) for c in cards}
    confirmed = {catalog.canonical_id(c["scheme_id"]) for c in cards if c.get("verification", "confirmed") == "confirmed"}
    research = (run or {}).get("research", {})

        "predicted": sorted(predicted),

        "predicted_likely": sorted(predicted - confirmed),

        "likely_unconfirmed_rules": {c["scheme_id"]: c.get("unconfirmed_rules", []) for c in cards

    data = json.load(open(FAMILIES, encoding="utf-8"))

    with neatlogs.trace("eval_suite", kind="WORKFLOW", households=len(households)):

    path = f"evals/results-{ts}.json"

From now on, every run saves its neatlogs trace and session IDs, both in the eval results files and in the app. The change is committed and pushed as `6eea250`, plus `4151898`, which updates `EVIDENCE.md` to link to it. I didn't run any evals or API calls; I tested offline with the model steps stubbed out and neatlogs export turned off.

**What gets saved:**
- **Each trace entry:** the trace ID, the span ID, the span name (e.g. `haq_run`), the workflow and the session ID (the household ID).
- **App runs:** each run keeps a list of trace entries. A resumed run adds one entry per attempt.
- **Interview turns and follow-ups:** the answer message stores the trace entry for that turn.
- **App API:** `GET /api/households/{id}` now returns the session ID and the run's trace entries.
- **Eval results:** each household has a `neatlogs` block with its trace ID, session ID and the run traces inside it. The top of the file has the suite's trace ID.

**One behaviour change in the evals:** before, every household was nested inside a single `eval_suite` trace, so they would all have shared one trace ID. Now each household is its own trace. It's linked back to the suite by a `suite_trace_id` field, which is also saved in the results.

**Checked offline:**
- Every household gets a distinct trace ID, whether households run in parallel or one after another.
- A household's run trace sits inside that household's trace.
- Resuming a run adds a second trace entry.
- The app API returns the trace entries.

The README describes the new fields. `EVIDENCE.md` still says the earlier runs have no trace IDs, because those runs happened before this change. The next eval run will be the first with real trace IDs in its results file.

def write(profile: dict, research: dict, usage: Usage, hid: str) -> dict:
    with neatlogs.trace("write", kind="CHAIN", session_id=hid):
        received = already_has(profile)
        cards = []
        for rec in research.values():
            if rec.get("status") not in ("verified", "likely"):
                continue
            likely = rec["status"] == "likely"
            seed = catalog.BY_ID.get(rec["scheme_id"], {})
            already = rec["scheme_id"] in received
            cards.append({
                "scheme_id": rec["scheme_id"],
                "emoji": seed.get("emoji", "📄"),
                "name_hi": rec["scheme_name_hi"],
                "name_en": seed.get("name_en", rec["scheme_id"]),
                "level": seed.get("level", "central"),
                "member": rec["member"],
                "benefit_hi": rec["benefit_hi"],
                "annual_value_inr": rec["annual_value_inr"],
                "verification": "likely" if likely else "confirmed",
                "label_en": LIKELY_LABEL_EN if likely else "Confirmed on official source",
                "label_hi": LIKELY_LABEL_HI if likely else "सरकारी स्रोत से पक्का",
                "unconfirmed_rules": rec.get("unconfirmed_rules", []),
                "counts_toward_total": rec["counts_toward_total"] and not already and not likely,
                "counts_toward_likely_total": rec["counts_toward_total"] and not already and likely,
                "already_receiving": already,
                "documents_hi": rec["documents_hi"],
                "where_to_apply_hi": rec["where_to_apply_hi"],
                "apply_url": rec["apply_url"],
                "official_url": rec["official_url"],
                "rules_checked": rec["rules_checked"],
                "assumptions_hi": rec["assumptions_hi"],
            })
        cards.sort(key=lambda c: (c["verification"] != "confirmed", -int(c["counts_toward_total"]),
                                  -c["annual_value_inr"]))
        total = sum(c["annual_value_inr"] for c in cards if c["counts_toward_total"])
        likely_total = sum(c["annual_value_inr"] for c in cards if c["counts_toward_likely_total"])

def run(hid: str, resume: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Run (or resume) the full pipeline for a household. Returns the finished run."""
    h = state.get(hid)
    last = h["runs"][-1] if h["runs"] else None
    run_ = last if (resume and last and last["status"] != "done") else state.start_run(hid)
    rid = run_["id"]

"""Haq web UI with the agent stubbed out, for screenshots and UI work. Makes NO model or web calls.

    .venv/bin/python scripts/ui_stub_server.py      # serves http://127.0.0.1:8001

The fake run emits the same live events as the real agent (including a website failure that is
recovered from another official source), then pauses until POST /stub/release, so the working screen
can be captured mid-run. Results include confirmed and "check needed" cards.
"""
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
os.environ.update(NEATLOGS_API_KEY="", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="stub-no-calls",
                  HAQ_STATE_FILE=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="haq-stub-"), "state.json"))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
os.chdir(ROOT)

import app as appmod  # noqa: E402
from haq import agent, intake, present, state  # noqa: E402

release = threading.Event()


def fake_run(hid, resume=True):
    h = state.get(hid)
    run = h["runs"][-1] if h["runs"] and h["runs"][-1]["status"] != "done" else state.start_run(hid)
    rid = run["id"]

    def ev(t, pause=0.35, **d):
        state.add_event(hid, rid, t, **d)
        time.sleep(pause)

    ev("understood", members=3)
    ev("planned", schemes=4)
    ev("checking", scheme_id="pm_kisan", from_cache=False)
    ev("recovered", scheme_id="pm_kisan", requested="https://pmkisan.gov.in/",
       served_by="https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pm-kisan", fell_back=True)
    ev("scheme_done", scheme_id="pm_kisan", outcome="confirmed")
    ev("checking", scheme_id="up_widow_pension", from_cache=True)
    ev("scheme_done", scheme_id="up_widow_pension", outcome="likely")
    ev("checking", scheme_id="pmay_g", from_cache=False)
    ev("checking", scheme_id="pmsby", from_cache=True)
    release.wait(timeout=120)          # hold here so the working screen can be captured
    ev("scheme_done", scheme_id="pmay_g", outcome="likely")
    ev("scheme_done", scheme_id="pmsby", outcome="confirmed")
    ev("writing")

    def card(sid, emoji, name, member, ben, val, ver, chk, docs, counts, where, url):
        return dict(scheme_id=sid, emoji=emoji, name_hi=name, name_en=name, member=member, benefit_hi=ben,
                    annual_value_inr=val, verification=ver, check_needed=chk, counts_toward_total=counts,
                    counts_toward_likely_total=(not counts) and val > 0, already_receiving=False,
                    documents_hi=docs, where_to_apply_hi=where, apply_url=url, official_url=url,
                    unconfirmed_rules=[], rules_checked=[], assumptions_hi="")
    csc = "नज़दीकी जन सेवा केंद्र (CSC) या ब्लॉक कार्यालय में आवेदन करें।"
    result = {
        "total_missing_inr_per_year": 6000, "likely_extra_inr_per_year": 12000,
        "summary_hi": "आपका परिवार हर साल छह हज़ार रुपये पक्का नहीं ले रहा है। दादी को विधवा पेंशन भी मिल सकती है, "
                      "उसके लिए आय सीमा की जाँच करवाएँ। कागज़ लेकर जन सेवा केंद्र जाइए।",
        "cards": [
            card("pm_kisan", "🌾", "पीएम किसान", "father", "हर साल ₹6,000, तीन किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में।", 6000,
                 "confirmed", [], ["आधार कार्ड", "बैंक पासबुक", "खतौनी (ज़मीन के कागज़)"], True, csc,
                 "https://pmkisan.gov.in/"),
            card("up_widow_pension", "🙏", "निराश्रित महिला पेंशन", "grandmother", "हर महीने ₹1,000 पेंशन, सीधे बैंक खाते में।",
                 12000, "likely", ["income_limit"], ["आधार कार्ड", "पति का मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र", "आय प्रमाण पत्र", "बैंक पासबुक"],
                 False, csc, "https://sspy-up.gov.in/"),
            card("pmay_g", "🏠", "पीएम आवास (ग्रामीण)", "household", "पक्का घर बनाने के लिए ₹1.2 लाख की मदद।", 0, "likely",
                 ["house", "area"], ["आधार कार्ड", "राशन कार्ड", "बैंक पासबुक"], False, csc, "https://pmayg.dord.gov.in/"),
            card("pmsby", "🦺", "PMSBY", "father", "सिर्फ़ ₹20 सालाना में ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा।", 0, "confirmed", [],
                 ["आधार कार्ड", "बैंक खाता", "मोबाइल नंबर"], False, "अपने बैंक की शाखा में फ़ॉर्म भरें।",
                 "https://jansuraksha.gov.in/"),
        ]}
    ev("done", pause=0)
    state.update_run(hid, rid, lambda r: r.update(result=result, status="done", stage="done"))


EN = {
    "summary": "Your family is missing ₹6,000 a year for sure. Grandmother may also get the widow pension — "
               "get the income limit checked. Take your documents to the Common Service Centre.",
    "benefit": ["₹6,000 every year in three instalments, straight to your bank account.",
                "₹1,000 pension every month, straight to the bank.",
                "₹1.2 lakh to help build a pucca house.",
                "₹2 lakh accident cover for just ₹20 a year."],
    "docs": [["Aadhaar card", "Bank passbook", "Khatauni (land record)"],
             ["Aadhaar card", "Husband's death certificate", "Income certificate", "Bank passbook"],
             ["Aadhaar card", "Ration card", "Bank passbook"],
             ["Aadhaar card", "Bank account", "Mobile number"]],
    "where": ["Apply at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or block office."] * 3
             + ["Fill the form at your bank branch."],
}


def fake_translate(hid, result):
    return {"summary": EN["summary"],
            "cards": [{"i": i, "member": c["member"], "benefit": EN["benefit"][i], "documents": EN["docs"][i],
                       "where_to_apply": EN["where"][i], "scheme_name": c["name_hi"]}
                      for i, c in enumerate(result["cards"])]}


def fake_extract(usage, **kw):
    p = {**intake.empty_profile(),
         "members": [intake._member(relation="self", age=40, gender="male", occupation="farmer")]}
    return {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k not in ("state", "assumptions")}


agent.run = fake_run
present._translate = fake_translate
intake.structured = fake_extract


@appmod.app.post("/stub/release")
def _release():
    release.set()
    return {"released": True}


@appmod.app.post("/stub/reset")
def _reset():
    release.clear()
    return {"reset": True}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(appmod.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8001")), log_level="warning")

content.text:
The redesign is finished, committed and pushed. The two files left over from yesterday went in as `ed8c510`, and the screenshot review fixes as `64f00c9`. Everything ran against the stub server; I made no real API calls.

**Screenshots:** `docs/screenshots/` has 15 phone-size shots, each screen in Hindi and English:
- language choice and start screen
- family builder, both as the phone shows it and scrolled to the end
- a tap follow-up question
- the working checklist, including "Website was down — verified from another official source ✓"
- results with both "Confirmed" and "Check needed" cards, plus a card with "Where to apply" open

**What I fixed after looking at them:**
- **Wrong icons:** "Khatauni (land record)" showed a bank icon, and the ration-card icon looked like a white blob.
- **Small tap targets:** the language toggle and the "Official source" and "Open website" links were under 44px.
- **Spinner:** the rotating hourglass on the working screen looked broken, so it's a proper spinner now.
- **Builder:** "Continue" fell below the screen once you added two members, so it's now pinned to the bottom. The member chips are an even two-column grid; I dropped the "+" so "Grandmother" fits on one line.
- **Console error:** the missing favicon caused the only console error, a 404.

None of the screens had overlapping or cut-off Hindi text. The final automated check is clean on all 15 screens: no overflow, no clipped text, no off-screen buttons, no tap target under 44px, and no console errors.

I also committed the stub server and screenshot script under `scripts/`, so the screenshots can be regenerated without API calls (instructions are in the README).

**To start the real app:**
```bash
cd ~/Desktop/Hackathon_1 && .venv/bin/uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```
Then open **http://localhost:8000** in Chrome.

This one uses real API credit: about $0.11–0.25 per family once the search starts. Speech input needs Chrome and microphone permission. To see the language screen again, clear the site data for localhost.

content.text:
All three fixes are done and pushed as `5e66a8c`. I re-took the screenshots in both languages using the stub server, so no real API calls.

1. **Headline:** it now leads with the total, including schemes that still need a check, and always shows the split underneath. With the sample family:
   - Hindi: "आपके परिवार का ₹18,000/साल तक का हक़ बाकी है", then "₹6,000 पक्का · ₹12,000 जाँच के बाद".
   - English: "Up to ₹18,000/year your family is owed", then "₹6,000 confirmed · ₹12,000 after checks".
   - The read-aloud says the same sentence and split. In Hindi it says "प्रति साल" where the screen shows "/साल", so the voice doesn't stumble on the slash.
   - The spoken summary written at the end of each run now uses the same wording, so it can't contradict the headline.
2. **Hindi scheme names:** Hindi mode shows official Hindi names on the cards and in the working checklist, e.g. "निराश्रित महिला पेंशन योजना". PM-KISAN, PMAY-G, PMSBY and PMJJBY stay as they are.
3. **Insurance:** PMSBY and PMJJBY are never added to the ₹ total. They appear in their own सुरक्षा / Protection section below the money cards, with a short note that the family pays the premium.
   - PMSBY shows "You pay ₹20/year" with "Accident cover ₹2 lakh".
   - PMJJBY shows "You pay ₹436/year" with "Life cover ₹2 lakh".
   - These figures are from jansuraksha.gov.in.
   - Totals are recalculated when results are shown, so results saved earlier also leave insurance out.

**Checks:** the layout check is clean on all 15 screens, with no console errors. I also confirmed both read-aloud texts directly in the page.

**One deviation:** this went in as a single commit rather than one per fix, because the same files carry all three changes. The commit message lists each fix separately.

"""Thin helpers around the traced Anthropic client: one call site, cost accounting."""
import json
import threading

from anthropic.types import Message

from .config import (EFFORT, FALLBACK_BODY, FALLBACK_HEADERS, FALLBACK_MODELS, MODEL, PRICES,
                     WEB_SEARCH_USD, client)


class Usage:
    """Thread-safe token/cost accumulator for one run."""

    FIELDS = ("input_tokens", "output_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens",
              "cache_creation_input_tokens", "web_search_requests")

    def __init__(self, initial: dict | None = None):
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self.totals = {k: 0 for k in self.FIELDS}
        self.totals["cost_usd"] = 0.0
        self.by_model: dict[str, dict] = {}
        if initial:
            self.totals.update({k: initial.get(k, v) for k, v in self.totals.items()})
            self.by_model = {m: dict(v) for m, v in (initial.get("by_model") or {}).items()}

    def add(self, msg: Message) -> None:
        u = msg.usage
        price = PRICES.get(msg.model) or PRICES.get(MODEL) or PRICES["claude-opus-5-5"]
        searches = getattr(getattr(u, "server_tool_use", None), "web_search_requests", 0) or 0
        vals = {
            "input_tokens": u.input_tokens or 0,
            "output_tokens": u.output_tokens or 0,
            "cache_read_input_tokens": u.cache_read_input_tokens or 0,
            "cache_creation_input_tokens": u.cache_creation_input_tokens or 0,
            "web_search_requests": searches,
        }
        cost = (vals["input_tokens"] * price["in"] + vals["output_tokens"] * price["out"]
                + vals["cache_read_input_tokens"] * price["cache_read"]
                + vals["cache_creation_input_tokens"] * price["cache_write"]) / 1e6
        cost += searches * WEB_SEARCH_USD
        with self._lock:
            for k, v in vals.items():
                self.totals[k] += v
            self.totals["cost_usd"] = round(self.totals["cost_usd"] + cost, 6)
            m = self.by_model.setdefault(msg.model, {**{k: 0 for k in self.FIELDS}, "calls": 0, "cost_usd": 0.0})
            for k, v in vals.items():
                m[k] += v
            m["calls"] += 1
            m["cost_usd"] = round(m["cost_usd"] + cost, 6)

Each scenario gets a fresh app server whose HAQ_BUDGET_USD is the remaining budget minus a safety
margin for calls already in flight, so the process refuses further model calls before the cap.
Total spend is read from every server (/api/debug/spend) and checked before each scenario.
Writes docs/stress/live-results.json.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import httpx

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
STATE = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "live-test-state.json")
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", "stress", "live-results.json")
MARGIN_PER_LOOP = 0.05      # worst-case spend of one in-flight research call after the cap trips

spent_total = 0.0
results = []


def start_server(port, budget, extra_env=None):
    env = {**os.environ, "HAQ_STATE_FILE": STATE, "HAQ_BUDGET_USD": f"{budget:.4f}", **(extra_env or {})}
    p = subprocess.Popen([os.path.join(ROOT, ".venv/bin/uvicorn"), "app:app", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", str(port)],
                         cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=open(f"/tmp/haq-live-{port}.log", "w"),
                         start_new_session=True)
    for _ in range(80):
        try:
            httpx.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/", timeout=1)
            return p
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.25)
    raise RuntimeError(f"server on {port} did not start")


def stop_server(p, port):
    global spent_total
    try:
        spent = httpx.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/debug/spend", timeout=5).json()["spent_usd"]
    except Exception:
        spent = None
    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    p.wait(timeout=20)
    if spent is not None:
        spent_total += spent
    return spent


def run_family(port, name, lang, builder=None, text=None, answers=None, timeout=900):
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    c = httpx.Client(timeout=120)
    t0 = time.time()
    rec = {"scenario": name, "lang": lang, "error": None}
    try:
        hid = c.post(f"{base}/api/households", json={"lang": lang}).json()["id"]
        rec["household_id"] = hid
        r = c.post(f"{base}/api/households/{hid}/intake", json={"lang": lang, **({"builder": builder} if builder else {"text": text})})
        r.raise_for_status()
        r = r.json()
        if r.get("need_more"):
            rec["error"] = "intake: family not understood"
            return rec
        rec["followups_asked"] = [(f["id"], f["question"]) for f in r["followups"]]
        if r["followups"]:
            chosen = {f["id"]: (answers or {}).get(f["id"], f["options"][0]["value"]) for f in r["followups"]}
            rec["followup_answers"] = chosen
            c.post(f"{base}/api/households/{hid}/answers", json={"lang": lang, "answers": chosen}).raise_for_status()
        while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
            d = c.get(f"{base}/api/households/{hid}?lang={lang}").json()
            run = d["run"]
            if run and run["status"] in ("done", "failed"):
                break
            time.sleep(3)
        rec["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        run, res = d["run"], d["result"]
        rec["status"] = run["status"] if run else "no-run"
        rec["run_error"] = run.get("error") if run else None
        rec["cost_usd"] = run["cost_usd"] if run else 0
        rec["neatlogs"] = {"session_id": hid, "trace_ids": [t["trace_id"] for t in (run or {}).get("traces", [])]}
        rec["recovery_events"] = [e for e in (run or {}).get("events", []) if e["type"] in ("recovered", "source_failed")]
        if res:
            money = [x for x in res["cards"] if x["category"] != "protection"]
            prot = [x for x in res["cards"] if x["category"] == "protection"]
            rec["headline"] = {"up_to": res["owed_up_to_inr_per_year"], "confirmed": res["total_missing_inr_per_year"],
                               "after_checks": res["likely_extra_inr_per_year"]}
            rec["confirmed"] = [f"{x['name']} ({x['member']})" for x in money if x["verification"] == "confirmed"]
            rec["check_needed"] = [f"{x['name']} ({x['member']}): {', '.join(x['check_needed'])}" for x in money
                                   if x["verification"] != "confirmed"]
            rec["protection"] = [f"{x['name']} ({x['member']})" for x in prot]
            rec["links"] = sorted({u for x in res["cards"] for u in (x["official_url"], x["apply_url"]) if u and u.startswith("http")})
    except Exception as e:
        rec["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300]
        rec["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    return rec


FAMILY_1 = {"members": [{"role": "mother", "tags": ["widow"]}, {"role": "father", "tags": ["farmer"]},
                        {"role": "daughter", "tags": ["student"]}], "income": "low"}
ANSWERS_1 = {"ration_card": "eligible_household", "land": "yes", "area": "rural", "house": "kutcha", "lpg": "yes"}
TEXT_2 = ("I live in a village in Sitapur district with my wife and my father. My father is 72 years old and disabled, "
          "he has a 60 percent disability certificate. I am 38 and work as a daily wage labourer, my wife is 34 and "
          "looks after the home. We earn about 6000 rupees a month. We have a ration card.")
ANSWERS_2 = {"house": "kutcha", "lpg": "no", "land": "no", "area": "rural"}
TEXT_3 = "मैं 74 साल की विधवा हूँ, गाँव में अकेली रहती हूँ, अंत्योदय राशन कार्ड है, कच्चा घर है, गैस नहीं है।"


def guarded(cap, est, label):
    if spent_total + est > cap:
        print(f"STOP before {label}: spent ${spent_total:.3f} + estimated ${est:.2f} would exceed ${cap:.2f}")
        return False
    return True


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--cap", type=float, default=2.0)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    cap = args.cap
    plan = [
        ("1-hindi-builder", 0.30, 8020, {}, [dict(name="1-hindi-builder", lang="hi", builder=FAMILY_1, answers=ANSWERS_1)]),
        ("2-english-typed-disabled-grandfather", 0.35, 8020, {}, [dict(name="2-english-typed", lang="en", text=TEXT_2, answers=ANSWERS_2)]),
        ("3-hindi-builder-SIMULATE_FAILURE", 0.60, 8021, {"SIMULATE_FAILURE": "1", "HAQ_NO_CACHE": "1"},
         [dict(name="3-simulate-failure", lang="hi", builder=FAMILY_1, answers=ANSWERS_1)]),
        ("4-three-concurrent", 0.70, 8020, {}, [
            dict(name="4a-concurrent-builder-en", lang="en", builder=FAMILY_1, answers=ANSWERS_1),
            dict(name="4b-concurrent-typed-en", lang="en", text=TEXT_2, answers=ANSWERS_2),
            dict(name="4c-concurrent-typed-hi", lang="hi", text=TEXT_3)]),
    ]
    for label, est, port, env, fams in plan:
        if not guarded(cap, est, label):
            break
        budget = max(0.0, cap - spent_total - MARGIN_PER_LOOP * 4 * len(fams))
        print(f"\n== {label}: server cap ${budget:.3f} (spent so far ${spent_total:.3f})", flush=True)
        p = start_server(port, budget, env)
        try:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(len(fams)) as pool:
                recs = list(pool.map(lambda f: run_family(port, **f), fams))
        finally:
            spent = stop_server(p, port)
        for r in recs:
            r["group"] = label
            results.append(r)
            print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ("scenario", "status", "error", "run_error", "seconds", "cost_usd", "headline",
                                                    "confirmed", "check_needed", "protection", "neatlogs")},
                             ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
            if r.get("recovery_events"):
                print("   recovery:", [(e["type"], e.get("scheme_id"), e.get("requested"), e.get("served_by")) for e in r["recovery_events"]])
        print(f"   server spend for {label}: ${spent}  | total so far ${spent_total:.4f} of ${cap:.2f}", flush=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    json.dump({"cap_usd": cap, "spent_usd": round(spent_total, 4), "runs": results}, open(OUT, "w"), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\nTOTAL SPENT ${spent_total:.4f} (cap ${cap:.2f}). Saved {OUT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Haq — Test Report (2026-10-11)

This report covers two phases of testing:

- **Phase 1** was free. It checked every link the app can show and stress-tested the UI against the stub server, with no model or web-search calls.
- **Phase 2** made real Anthropic API calls through the real app server, under a hard total cap of $2.

Raw data:

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `docs/stress/links.txt` and `links.json` | link check results |
| `docs/stress/report.json` | UI stress test results |
| `docs/stress/live-results.json` | real API runs |
| `docs/stress/live-results-links.json` | links on the real results screens |

Scripts: `scripts/check_links.py`, `scripts/stress_ui.py`, `scripts/live_test.py` and `scripts/ui_stub_server.py`.

---

## Phase 1A — Links (free)

**What was checked:** every URL the app can show. That covers the catalog (official, rules-document and fallback URLs), the cached scheme rules, cards in saved results (after the display-link fixes), the evals source URLs, and links in `static/index.html` and the stub.

**How each URL was checked:**

1. A real GET request with a browser user-agent, a 15-second timeout, one retry, and redirects followed.
2. If that failed, the URL was re-checked in **real Chrome**.
3. Every myScheme page was also rendered. myScheme returns HTTP 200 for any URL, even when the page shows "Page not found".

**What was broken (as a family's browser sees it) and what replaced it.** Each replacement is an official page that was verified in Chrome by its title and text.

| Broken URL | Problem | Replaced by |
|---|---|---|
| pmjay.gov.in | times out | beneficiary.nha.gov.in |
| nsap.nic.in | DNS failure | nsap.dord.gov.in |
| pmayg.nic.in | DNS failure | pmayg.dord.gov.in |
| abhyuday.up.gov.in | connection refused | samajkalyan.up.gov.in (the UP Social Welfare department, which runs Abhyudaya; the page does not name the scheme) |
| old.financialservices.gov.in/…PMJJBY | DNS failure | financialservices.gov.in/pradhan-mantri-jeevan-jyoti-bima-yojana-pmjjby |
| financialservices.gov.in/beta/…pmsby | certificate name mismatch | financialservices.gov.in/pradhan-mantri-suraksha-bima-yojana-pmsby |
| pmkmy.gov.in | certificate name mismatch | pmkisan.gov.in |
| sspy-up.gov.in | certificate warning in browsers | per scheme: mahilakalyan.up.nic.in (widow), divyangjan.upsdc.gov.in (disability), samajkalyan.up.gov.in (old age) |
| myscheme …/ab-pmjay, …/abpmjayvv | "Page not found" | beneficiary.nha.gov.in |
| myscheme …/oaps-up | "Page not found" | samajkalyan.up.gov.in |
| myscheme …/pmkmy | "Page not found" | pmkisan.gov.in |
| myscheme …/pmsym | "Page not found" | maandhan.in |
| myscheme …/mksy | **wrong scheme** (Mukhyamantri *Kisan Sahay* Yojana) | mksy.up.gov.in |
| myscheme …/pmvs | **wrong scheme** (PM-*Vidyalaxmi*) | pmvishwakarma.gov.in |

**Result:** 60 of 60 links load in Chrome.

Thirteen links still fail Python's strict TLS check. They are all missing an intermediate certificate (one has the legacy-renegotiation problem). Browsers handle these, so families are not affected.

**How the fixes are applied:**

- **Display:** `catalog.display_link()` maps known-broken URLs on every card. It also covers results saved earlier.
- **Fetching:** dead hosts were removed from the fetch lists.
- **Cache:** the cached rules were rewritten.
- **Evals:** `evals/families.json` keeps each evidence URL, because that is where the rule text was read. 13 items gained a `browser_url`. Expected answers did not change; the file was verified identical apart from the added fields.

## Phase 1B — UI stress (free)

**Setup:** Playwright with real Chrome, against the stub server, in both languages, at widths of 360, 390 and 768 px.

**What was covered:**

- inputs: empty, gibberish, emoji only, 2,000 characters, Hinglish, numbers only
- microphone permission denied
- speech API missing
- double and triple taps on every button
- "Continue" with no family members
- a sweep for buttons that do nothing
- a hit-test that every visible button is tappable, i.e. not covered by another element
- switching language mid-run and on results
- the back button and refresh during the working screen
- the server killed mid-run, then restarted
- slow 3G, and going offline then back online
- 25 concurrent sessions

**What broke and was fixed:**

| Found | Fix |
|---|---|
| Gibberish, emoji-only and numbers-only text was accepted with **no family**, and the app went on to ask follow-up questions (18 cases) | The intake step returns `need_more`, and the UI asks again or offers the tap builder |
| Empty typed input did nothing, with no message | A hint is shown |
| "Continue" with no members did nothing (dead button) | A hint is shown |
| With the server killed mid-run, the working screen froze silently | A "Connection lost — reconnecting…" notice appears, and the screen resumes when the server is back |
| The headline 🔊 button was **covered by the headline text**: taps hit the text and nothing was read aloud | Fixed with `z-index` and padding. The test now hit-tests every button |
| "Have a question?" without the speech API jumped to the *start* typing screen and sent the question as a new family | It has its own typed fallback on the results screen |
| A blocked microphone fell through to "didn't catch that" | The UI switches to typing and shows a message |
| Double or triple taps could send twice, and could skip a follow-up question | One request per action. A tap answers exactly one question |
| Requests failing while offline showed a generic error | An "offline" message is shown |
| A long text was sent to the model in full | Text is capped at 3,000 characters on the server |
| 25 concurrent sessions took about 33 s each, because the state file was re-parsed on every poll | The state is parsed once per process. Sessions now take 17–23 s |

**Final run:** STRESS_RESULT_PLACEHOLDER

## Phase 2 — Real API (hard cap $2)

**Setup:** the real app server was driven over HTTP, making the same calls the browser makes. Each scenario got a fresh server whose `HAQ_BUDGET_USD` was set to the remaining budget minus a safety margin. That server refuses any model call once the cap is reached. Every model call is counted, including intake extraction and translation.

**Total spent: $1.52 of $2.00.**

| # | Run | Status | Time | Cost | neatlogs trace ID (session) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hindi tap builder: mother is a widow, father is a farmer, daughter is a student, low income | ✅ done | 48 s | $0.245 | `7ad95bd365bfdb0f4c49652228f19c2d` (`8936735b31`) |
| 2 | English typed family with a disabled 72-year-old grandfather | ✅ done | 75 s | $0.243 | `86f478b4537648b5e25dd329456e6391` (`3860bdfa10`) |
| 3 | Same as run 1 with `SIMULATE_FAILURE=1` and the cache off | ✅ done | 88 s | $0.457 | `28204345122d65f99265fd532cb580c2` (`b850d82182`) |
| 4a | Concurrent: tap builder (English) | stopped at its server cap, then **resumed → ✅ done** | 39 s + 19 s | $0.182 + resume | `f26e7f92c01357d7969673ff0dd3995f`, `28f03054bdf0a11cd098e6244f1b575d` (`2021a924e6`) |
| 4b | Concurrent: typed (English) | stopped at its server cap, then **resumed → ✅ done** | 45 s + 46 s | $0.207 + resume | `dbc896599795be0b097f18b9231887c6`, `83c01b7d25f3cd36d20ad44ae35929a2` (`df30875aaf`) |
| 4c | Concurrent: typed (Hindi), a widow aged 74 | ✅ done | 33 s | $0.119 | `8a345750c8713575224289c188bca376` (`aa820aab3e`) |

The two resumed runs cost $0.061 together, because the rules cache meant very little work was redone.

**Schemes found** (as returned by each run):

- **Run 1.**
  - Confirmed: PM-KISAN (father), Kanya Sumangala (daughter), PMFBY (father), e-Shram (mother, father).
  - Check needed: PMAY-G (area, house), widow pension (income limit), Ujjwala (income limit, LPG), PM-JAY (income limit).
  - Protection: PMSBY, PMJJBY.
- **Run 2.**
  - Confirmed: PMAY-G, Ayushman Vay Vandana (father), PM-SYM, e-Shram.
  - Check needed: old-age pension, disability pension, PM-KISAN, Ujjwala, PM-JAY.
  - Protection: PMSBY, PMJJBY.
- **Run 3.**
  - Confirmed: PM-KISAN, Kanya Sumangala, UP scholarship (daughter), PMFBY, PM-SYM.
  - Check needed: PMAY-G, widow pension, Ujjwala, e-Shram.
- **Run 4c.**
  - Confirmed: PMAY-G, Ujjwala, Ayushman Vay Vandana.
  - Check needed: widow pension, old-age pension, PM-JAY.

**Links on the real results screens:** 24 of 24 load in Chrome (`docs/stress/live-results-links.json`).

### What the real runs exposed, and the fixes

1. **One-time grants were counted as money per year** (this broke the "honest headline" rule).
   - PMAY-G's ₹1.2 lakh house grant, Ujjwala's ₹2,050 gas connection and Kanya Sumangala's stage payments were all added to "/year". Run 1 showed "up to **₹1,52,050/year**".
   - **Fix:** `catalog.ONE_TIME` sets these schemes apart. They appear as a separate line ("+ ₹X one-time help (not every year)"), and each card says "one-time".
   - Run 1 now reads: **up to ₹18,000/year** (₹6,000 confirmed and ₹12,000 after checks), plus ₹1,34,050 of one-time help.
2. **The same person was counted for two pensions** (run 4c: widow pension plus old-age pension).
   - In UP a person gets one social pension at a time.
   - **Fix:** only one pension is counted per person, and the card explains why.

# Haq business plan (made with cfo.ai)

These are exports from cfo.ai. The forecast runs for 24 months, from Nov 2026 (month 1) to Oct 2028 (month 24), and covers three scenarios: Main, Conservative and Growth. A summary is in the [README](../../README.md#business-plan-made-with-cfoai).

- `assumptions.xlsx`: every input of the Main scenario, with its value, unit, basis (MEASURED / ASSUMED) and a short explanation.
- `monthly-plan.xlsx`: the Main scenario's month-by-month P&L and cash flow for all 24 months, covering customers, checks, revenue, AI cost, payroll and ending cash.
- `economics.xlsx`: unit economics per check for each customer type (CSC, CSR, employer) at ₹20, ₹10 and ₹4 AI cost; the scenario decisions; and the break-even sensitivity matrix.
- `calculation-checks.xlsx`: the monthly decision checks (future minimum profit, acquisition top-up) and the break-even sensitivity behind the economics sheet.
- `forecast-dashboard.xlsx`: a side-by-side comparison of the three scenarios (break-even, minimum cash, funding needed, acquisition spend), plus the model inputs for all three.

Some cells hold values that cfo.ai calculated rather than live formulas, so they do not recalculate. Each workbook's `Export notes` sheet lists them.

So ₹20 and ₹10 match **one-person** households. Multi-member families cost about twice as much (see the risks below).

### Key risky assumptions

1. **AI cost falls to ₹4 per check from month 10.** This is a target. At the measured ₹20 the plan never breaks even, and CSC and CSR checks lose money. The Conservative case, which stays at ₹10, needs ₹24.7 lakh of extra funding.
